small_claims_locations.notes: (530) 623-1208; divisions open 8:00 AM-4:00 PM M-F.

self_help_center.name: Access to Justice / Trinity Self-Help Center
self_help_center.address: Main floor, 11 Court Street, Weaverville, CA 96093
self_help_center.notes: First come, first served; call Court Services for current hours. Helps with forms; small claims page links here for form help.

small_claims_advisor.provider: None: court has exempted itself from CCP 116.940(b) advisory services (Local Rule 4.17)
small_claims_advisor.format: Court Self-Help Center (530) 623-1208 helps with forms; small claims packet on site.
small_claims_advisor.notes: Local Rule 4.17: 'This court exempts itself from the small claims advisory service requirements set forth in Code of Civil Procedure §116.940(b).' Rules document labeled 'Current Local Rules' bears effective date July 1, 2021. Statute still requires minimum advisory services from exempt courts.

e_filing_notes: No e-filing service listed on the court's Online Services or Forms & Filing pages.
remote_hearings_notes: Remote appearance page: 'Civil, Small Claims, Family Law, Probate' follow CRC 3.672 / CCP 367.75; Zoom appearance only on an approved request (RA-010/RA-015). Contact courtclerks@trinitycounty.org.
local_notes: Small claims page still states $10,000 limit (outdated).
notes: Under CCP 116.940(c), a court averaging 1,000 or fewer small claims filings a year may exempt itself by local rule but must still provide minimum advisory services. [2026-11-07 e_filing, still unverified: Still unclear. Not re-checked in depth this round; prior round found no e-filing service on Online Services or Forms & Filing pages.]

court_name: Superior Court of California, County of Ventura

small_claims_locations.name: Hall of Justice (all small claims filings)
small_claims_locations.notes: All small claims must be filed here regardless of hearing location; clerk M-F 8:00 AM-4:00 PM. No fax filing.

small_claims_locations.name: Juvenile Justice Center (Courtroom J6)
small_claims_locations.notes: Hearings for claims arising in all other county ZIP codes.

self_help_center.name: Civil Self-Help Center
self_help_center.address: Ventura: 800 South Victoria Avenue, Room 106; Oxnard: 4353 E. Vineyard Avenue, Room 206
self_help_center.notes: Does NOT assist with small claims cases. Phone/Zoom appointments via calendly.com/vcscreservations; email form.

small_claims_advisor.provider: Ventura County District Attorney's Office (Small Claims Advisors)
small_claims_advisor.format: Phone; Monday-Friday 8:00 AM-12:00 PM and 1:00-5:00 PM. Court says the DA's advisor is located in the courthouse in Ventura.
small_claims_advisor.notes: DA Consumer Mediation Unit also provides free day-of-hearing mediation at court.

e_filing_notes: Since Dec 9, 2024, documents eligible for e-filing in small claims may be filed through an approved EFSP. Small claims exhibits up to 10 pages may be emailed to SCtrials@ventura.courts.ca.gov.
remote_hearings_notes: Remote appearances page lists Zoom links for small claims courtrooms J6 (Oxnard) and S1 (Simi Valley) with the 'Information for Small Claims Parties' sheet (VSC-SC-001), which explains appearing remotely.
local_notes: Debt-collection claims need a written calculation of the debt. Pre-filing mediation: Conflict Resolution Institute, 4475 Market Street, Suite C, Ventura, (805) 384-1313.

small_claims_locations.name: Yolo Superior Court, Small Claims Division

self_help_center.name: Self-Help Center / Family Law Facilitator
self_help_center.notes: Walk-in Tue & Thu 8:30 AM-2:30 PM; live chat Mon/Wed/Fri; email form; appointments. Helps with small claims.

small_claims_advisor.notes: A Davis community wiki lists a different advisor number (530-752-4304) - secondary and possibly stale; court number recorded.
